chip.description: Two-channel waveform address/frequency generator for an external 4-bit waveform PROM (32 bytes per waveform, eight waveforms), volume and waveform selection supplied by a companion AY-3-8910; the SCC sound of Konami Bubble System hardware.
chip.notes: src/devices/sound/k005289.cpp in MAME 0.288: "The 005289 is a 2 channel sound generator. Each channel gets its waveform from a prom (4 bits wide) ... The 005289 itself is nothing but an address generator." Filed sound-wavetable per taxonomy A4/§4.13 (waveform held in ROM, looped at a programmable rate); TB4 keeps the address-generator role inside its own branch.
